confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'this is almost certainly the idler (jockey) pulley wearing out or the drive belt glazing over'

unjustifiedPart.evidence: 'you will need to replace both the idler pulley assembly and the drive belt'

rationale: The assistant did correctly unplug and have the customer turn the drum, but it never asked about levelling, never tried to localise the noise, and did not rule out drum rollers or the condensate pump. It jumped to 'almost certainly' the jockey pulley or belt and told the customer to buy a pulley and belt kit before any panel inspection. It also ignored the customer's back-injury constraint, which would make an engineer the more sensible route, and only offered one as an alternative.
